<!-- Adding a game? Keep this checklist; otherwise delete it. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->
- [ ] One new file in `games/`, named after the game (e.g. `some-game.json`)
- [ ] `windows.saves` checked on a real PC, or `verified` is `false`
- [ ] `windows.exe` taken from Task Manager's Details tab while the game runs
- [ ] `example` added and `npm test` passes
